findings.reason: the done-when must either drop parent or name the derivation as accepted, and a `done` declaration resting on a non-independent column has to be re-earned.
findings.text: §3's done-when requires "the code, title and parent read through the API equal those read through the ITER document assistant's record tools", but the receipt behind the cited evidence states "parent_code is derived here from the code by dropping its last dot-separated segment; the record tool returns no parent field" (/home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/icp/pbs-comparison-receipt.json), so the reference side of the parent column is computed from the same code it is meant to check and cannot disagree; §3 is then declared `done` at plan.html:50 on a parent measure its named reference cannot supply, and the s3 comment (plan.html:96) even records the review as having "no total score" when the stored review total is 100

findings.reason: as written, a node dispatched at §4 spends its budget rediscovering that the allowed route serves no file, and the plan must settle the decision (or defer §4) before the section is declared buildable.
findings.text: the new `document-source` decision is recorded with no choice, no author and no date, yet §4 (plan.html:55-56) is `implementable` and asserts "The file is read through the integration instance, the only data host section 2 allows", while that decision's own context measures the opposite: the integration instance holds no production documents, its only document-like records declare no file property, and file requests were refused 401 before and after a session renewal; §4's done-when (plan.html:57) requires one spreadsheet and one PDF fetched at a stated version, an outcome the plan's own measurement says the allowed host does not serve, and `iter-signal-context-and-enrichment#s4` depends on this section for the pilot documents

findings.reason: if the widened scope is not ratified the delivered change is reverted, so the section cannot stand as done until the ratification is answered and cited.
findings.text: §3 is declared `done` while its own comment records a review whose findings include a delivered change outside the node's declared write paths that "the coordinator must ratify the widened scope or revert those two files" (docs/state/imas-codex/reviews/run/r-20261115T213921030036-icp-plant-structure-and-component-reads/r-20261116T040900239445-review-of-icp-plant-structure-and-component-reads-21bb64f64115.json, finding f158a5f5048), and the plan's comment (plan.html:96) names neither that record nor the open item
